name: Sou, Atashi-tachi wa Konna ni mo Rifujin na Sekai ni Ikiteiru no dara yo
original_name: そう、あたしたちはこんなにも理不尽な世界に生きているのだらよ
source:
The protagonist's bus gets hijacked with everyone inside becoming hostages. Together with another passenger, a girl named Kako, he manages to persuade the hijacker to release all passengers. But in the meantime the bus drives into a magic bomb barrier. The situation becomes desperate, but luckily Kako turns out to be a magician with the ability to defuse magical bombs.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公乘坐的巴士被劫持，车上所有人都成了人质。他和另一位乘客——一个名叫花子的女孩一起，成功说服劫持者释放了所有乘客。但与此同时，巴士驶入了魔法炸弹结界。情况变得绝望，但幸运的是，花子原来是一名拥有拆除魔法炸弹能力的魔法师。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
